title: Story poll: would you let AI move your ad budget without asking?
hook: Would you let AI move your ad budget without asking you first?
caption:
Story pack (no feed caption).

A poll on where people draw the line with AI and ad budgets. Frame 2 is the poll. Frame 3 says where Galvor stands. Frame 4 is the tip: write down what a tool may do alone and what needs a person's yes.
alt_text: Five vertical story frames. Frame 1 asks: would you let AI move your ad budget without asking? Frame 2 is a poll with four options, from it can act alone to keep it away. Frame 3: we never touch the media budget. Frame 4 tip: write one line on what a tool may do alone and what needs a person's yes. Frame 5 asks people to follow @galvor.ai.

slides.headline: Would you let AI move your ad budget *without asking?*
AI and your ad budget. *Where is your line?*
We *never touch* the media budget
slides.body:
Galvor says what to scale, cut or shift, and why.

A person on your team makes the move.

slides.headline: Write the line down *before* the tool goes live
slides.body:
One sentence is enough: what it may do alone, and what needs a person's yes.

Pin it where the team can see it.

slides.headline: Your budget, *your call.*
slides.sub: We will share the poll result tomorrow.
